candidate.definition_en: A large area of land in the country owned by a person or family, or all the money and property that someone leaves when they die.
candidate.explanation_ar: ممتلكات كبيرة زي الأراضي والبيوت، أو كل الفلوس والأملاك اللي بيسيبها الشخص بعد وفاته.

senses.definition_en: A large area of land in the country, usually with a large house, owned by one person, family, or organization.
senses.definition_ar: عزبة أو ممتلكات شاسعة في الريف يملكها شخص أو عائلة.
examples: The family estate was sold to pay debts.

senses.definition_en: All the money, property, and possessions that a person owns, especially everything left when they die.
senses.definition_ar: تركة (جميع أموال وممتلكات الشخص، خاصة ما يتركه بعد وفاته).
examples: His estate was divided among his children.
The family estate was sold to pay debts.
His estate was divided among his children.
candidate.mnemonic: شبه كلمة 'State' 'دولة'.. الـ 'Estate' الكبيرة بتبقى زي دولة صغيرة لصحابها
